what_to_detect: A continuous record in which a static contributes only while the source carries the solved designation (gen-3 designations).
near_miss: The same static applying on the board with the permanent unsolved, no contribution.

what_to_detect: A trigger record for a trigger conditioned on its source being solved (an IsPresent$ condition on the solved designation), fired only when the source is solved.
near_miss: The same trigger evaluated with the source unsolved (fired false).
